description: This Java source file defines a class `DelegateViaDownstreamPeerCommandHandler` which implements the `Handler<CommandContext>` interface. The class handles command messages by delegating them to downstream peers via a sender obtained through a supplier function. It manages asynchronous sending of command messages, logging, error handling, and tracing.

classes.name: DelegateViaDownstreamPeerCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles command message delegation to downstream peer by setting message target address and managing asynchronous send flow.

methods.name: DelegateViaDownstreamPeerCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor accepting a supplier function to create a sender for delegated commands based on tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a CommandContext by retrieving the command, creating a sender, sending the command message, and handling success or failure.
